title: Romantic Getaway to India: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to India. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: India sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Adventure Crew
content:
The magic of India lies in its ability to surprise you at every turn. This guide is for anyone planning a romantic getaway to India who wants to experience the real heart of this incredible destination.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over India
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic India](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1496372412473-e8548ffd82bc?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

A private boat tour around India at sunset is the perfect way to create lasting memories together.

## Where to Stay

Charming bed and breakfasts in India provide cozy accommodations with home-cooked breakfasts.
